title: Suitcases to Osaka · teamLab Planets · Toyosu Christmas market and onsen · Aqua Symphony · Fuunji · NOAH at Korakuen · Golden Gai Friday

stops.name: Send suitcases to Kujō House (Yamato TA-Q-BIN)
stops.plan: Big suitcases go to Kujō House, Osaka, by Yamato TA-Q-BIN from the front desk or the nearest konbini, for Mon 21 Dec evening delivery (host confirmed). Keep overnight bags for Hakone.
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nagasaki, Seibu Ikebukuro line → Ikebukuro, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho line → Toyosu, Yurikamome → Shin-Toyosu, about 70 min

stops.name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
stops.plan: Booked 10:00 slot for 8 (online only, no door sales; the suitcase run rules out 09:00): barefoot through the water rooms and the floating flower garden. Shorts or roll-up trousers.

stops.name: Tokyo Christmas Market – Shin-Toyosu (waterfront)
stops.plan: Weekday entry with the mug (KKday advance tickets): glühwein, sausages and pretzels by the water as a light lunch.
stops.price: ¥1,000 pp entry, plus food and drinks

stops.name: Manyo Club Toyosu (Senkyaku Banrai)
stops.plan: 1h45 in the baths and the rooftop foot bath with a Tokyo Bay view, yukata and towels included. Anyone with tattoos is refused, so check before you go.
stops.transport: Yurikamome Shijo-mae → Daiba, then walk to Odaiba Seaside Park, about 31 min

stops.name: Tokyo Aqua Symphony
stops.plan: The giant fountain show off Odaiba Seaside Park: catch the next show after 15:15 (shows run from about 15:00, about 10 min each; wind cancels them, so check that morning's schedule). The Unicorn Gundam at DiverCity is gone, so it is not on the plan.
stops.transport: Rinkai line Tokyo Teleport → Osaki, JR Saikyo line rapid → Shinjuku, walk from the South Exit to Fuunji, about 52 min; be in the queue by 16:40

stops.name: Fuunji
stops.plan: Queue by 16:40 for the 17:00 dinner opening, buy tickets at the machine: Tokyo's benchmark tsukemen, eaten in waves at the small counter.
stops.transport: Toei Shinjuku line Shinjuku → Ichigaya, JR Chuo-Sobu local line → Suidobashi, about 34 min

stops.name: Korakuen Hall
stops.plan: Pro Wrestling NOAH Thanksgiving 2026 (unconfirmed: watch noah.co.jp/schedule and e+ from mid-November; buy 8 together). Fallback if there is no show or no tickets: go straight to Shinjuku for Kabukichō Tower's yokocho hall and the namco arcade in the tower.
stops.transport: JR Chuo-Sobu local line Suidobashi → Shinjuku, walk to Kabukichō, about 40 min

stops.name: Kabukichō Tower
stops.plan: Kabuki Yokocho on the 2nd floor: neon food hall with shared tables that seat all 8. Rounds and snacks, then a lap of the namco arcade upstairs.

stops.name: Ramen Nagi (Golden Gai)
stops.plan: Upstairs niboshi ramen with 10 counter seats: eat in two waves while the others pick the first bars.

stops.name: Golden Gai round 2
stops.plan: Friday bar-hop in two groups of four (most bars seat 6–10): seat charges ¥500–1,500, cash. Ignore touts and club invites, no nightclubs. Home by taxi; tomorrow is a 09:00 start for Hakone.
stops.transport: Taxi to Ninja House, 2 cars, 20 min (about ¥4,500 per car, about ¥1,100 pp)
